description: How widespread is GH10 across cyanobacteria, and is it conserved within Thermosynechococcus?
code:
import requests, collections, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
# Taxonomic spread of GH10 (PF00331) within Cyanobacteriota
url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
params={"query":"(xref:pfam-PF00331) AND (taxonomy_id:1117)","fields":"accession,organism_name,length,protein_name","size":500,"format":"json"}
r=requests.get(url,params=params,headers=H,timeout=120)
items=r.json()["results"]
print("cyanobacterial GH10 entries retrieved:", len(items))
orgs=collections.Counter(i["organism"]["scientificName"] for i in items)
gen=collections.Counter(o.split()[0] for o in orgs)
print("distinct organisms:", len(orgs), "| distinct genera:", len(gen))
print("top genera:", gen.most_common(12))
print("\nThermosynechococcus entries:")
for i in items:
    if "Thermosynechococcus" in i["organism"]["scientificName"]:
        print("  ", i["primaryAccession"], i["organism"]["scientificName"], i["sequence"]["length"])
